scope: P19 unified tool, round and all-content entries; explicit file navigation
author: architecture
changes: Tool, settled-round and top-level entries use reported-artifact counts; transcript counts are calculated once.
The passive unified list hands an exact current entry to the pane; pane rechecks thread/cwd/scope/report immediately before handing the explicitly selected path to OpenedFileView.
Transient content ownership rejects handlers after hide, inactivity, directory/thread/scope changes; navigation delayed by BrowserSurfaceGuard checks ownership again.
File requests now carry cwd. A new report for the same path does not remount an explicitly opened file or replace its reading/feedback owner.
Existing diff/output presentation and missing historical round boundary behavior remain. No fallback to another scope.

redEvidence.reason: Completed resource-link or edit location alone did not expose tool/round entries or a file list.
Captured file handler still selected after hide/inactive/cwd/scope/hide-return; another thread was already rejected.

classification: Two harness issues: module-init host_performance_origin is not file reading; ThreadPage SSR needs an explicit synchronous store snapshot in the harness. No production compatibility workaround.

Four implementation regressions: over-restricting expired scope callbacks removed the existing unavailable boundary entry/message. Restored the original behavior; ArtifactPane.rounds.test.tsx remained unchanged.
Harness did not traverse the header ReactNode prop passed from ThreadPage to ThreadView; corrected traversal only.

intermediateResults.boundary: Actual BrowserSurfaceGuard plus a controlled Promise, not a native browser run.

boundaries: This is the implementation author receipt, not an independent review.
New entry tests use real components in SSR/hook-controlled fixtures. No formal app, Agent, user file or database was operated.
Passive-render assertions prohibit file_/browser_/settings_ calls. Module-init host_performance_origin is recorded separately; no claim of zero total IPC.
The same-path test proves stable OpenedFileView key/reading ref, not cold feedback persistence or disk-version end-to-end behavior.
File inspection, permission, save and feedback storage production paths were not changed. Browser, installed and real-Agent proof remain separate.
ThreadView is 1366 lines, ArtifactPane 638, ThreadPage 548; all below 1500.
No full-repository tests were rerun by this author. Root owns final integration.
